sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Vinod Kumar Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ramesh Sinha,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of the petitioner is taken on record.

This petition seeks issuance of a writ in the nature of Certiorari quashing the impugned F.I.R. dated 08.02.2023 registered as F.I.R. No. 0085 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C.,
Police Station Mankapur, District Gonda.
Heard Shri Vinod Kumar,
learned Counsel for the petitioner, Shri Arun Kumar Pandey, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the impugned F.I.R. as well as material brought on record.

Learned Counsel for the petitioner has argued that that in the impugned F.I.R., it has been alleged that the elder uncle of the complainant/respondent no.3, namely, Shyam Narain son of Beepat died issueless on 05.11.2017 and after that, the property of Shyam Narain mutated in the name of the complainant/ respondent no.3 and Ram Chandra Mishra son of Beepat by way of PA11, but Ram Chandra Mishra, with the connivance of the petitioner and other co-accused, had executed a forged Brijesh Kumar Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home ...

entities.text: Brijesh Kumar Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127516515/
1 Will Deed on 29.03.2019 after two years from the death of Shyam Narain.

He argued that the complainant/respondent no.3 has filed a suit, bearing Regular Suit No. 1048 of 2021, before the Civil Judge (Junior Division), Gonda on 31.03.2021 for cancellation of the aforesaid Will deed and the same is still pending.

He argued that the allegations made in the impugned F.I.R. are absolutely forged and frivolous and the complainant/respondent no.3 has lodged the impugned F.I.R. only to create pressure for compromise in the aforesaid civil suit, hence the impugned F.I.R. is liable to be quashed.
Learned Additional Government Advocate, on the other hand, has opposed the aforesaid prayer of the learned Counsel for the petitioner.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, particularly the facts that the allegations made in the impugned F.I.R. appear to be civil in nature and Civil Suit No. 1048 of 2021 is pending before the concerned Court between the parties regarding cancellation of the Will deed, we are of the view that prima facie, a case for interim relief is made out.
Steps be taken within a week.
Let counter affidavit be filed within four weeks.
Rejoinder affidavit may be filed within two weeks thereafter.

Till the next date of listing or till submission of police report under Section 173 (2) Cr.P.C., if any,
before the competent Court, whichever is earlier, the arrest of the petitioner, Brijesh Kumar Mishra,
in pursuance of the impugned F.I.R., shall remain stayed, of course subject to the restraint that he shall fully co-operate with the investigation and shall appear as and when called upon to assist the investigation.
.

(Narendra Kumar Johari, J.) (Ramesh Sinha, J.) Order Date :- 21.2.2023/Ajit/-
